pre_coding_anomalies.description: Work-order presented a sketch of the BBC formula that did NOT match the paper's verbatim eq.(1). Two corrections were required before any code was written:

corrections.paper_actual: log(K_0)*log(2) = sum_{s>=1} (zeta(2s)-1)/s * A_s with NO outer alternating sign (the alternation is internal to A_s via (-1)^{m-1})
corrections.citation: BBC 1997 eq.(1), p.2; A_s in Lemma 1(a), p.3

corrections.paper_actual: log(K_0)*log(2) = sum ...; one must divide by log(2) to recover log(K_0)
corrections.implication: implementation must compute the series result then divide by an Arb ball for log(2)

pre_coding_anomalies.resolution: Both corrections incorporated into bbc_series.py from the start. Discrepancy is documented in BBC_FORMULA_VERIFIED.md (verification artefact) and surfaced here for synth review.

in_session_halts.description: First smoke test at P_bits=7178 produced K_0 radius ~10^{-2157}, falling ~3 dps short of the 2160-dps target. Diagnosed as Arb internal-precision rounding accumulation across ~3700 BBC series terms.
in_session_halts.resolution: Introduced GUARD_BITS=128 internal-precision uplift. Re-ran: K_0 radius now <= 10^{-2184} at P_bits=7178; well above target across all three ladder rungs.
